verdict.rationale: Skyvern's debugging docs say every run automatically captures browser session recordings, per-step screenshots, the AI's reasoning and network traffic. They also describe diagnosing failed runs from status, failure category, recording and logs. A community user separately praises the observability of workflow steps. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a step-by-step action timeline view (it is only implied by per-step screenshots and reasoning), deeper hands-on corroboration of video replay for failure debugging.
